Diplomacy colours: toggle button: colour players by diplomatic stance (ally, enemy, neutral) instead of their own colours
Perspective: accessible name of the list choosing whose view of the match to show (observer or a player)
Sound off: button label while sound is off; pressing it turns sound on
Master: label of the master volume slider
Effects: label of the sound effects volume slider
Match time: accessible name of the match clock
Minimap: accessible name of the minimap canvas; also the label of the folded minimap tab
Follow with the camera: accessible name of the portrait button that moves the camera to the selected unit
Frames per second: accessible name of the frame rate readout
Network statistics: accessible name of a debug panel
Profiling statistics: accessible name of a debug panel
Memory and storage statistics: accessible name of a debug panel
Playback speed: accessible name of the replay speed list
Timeline: accessible name of the replay slider
Live: button that jumps playback to the live edge of the match
Current match: button that returns from a replay, or from a stored match opened by its link, to the match in progress
Copy link: button that copies a link to the match at the moment playback is at
Link copied: label the same button shows for 2 seconds after copying the link
Benchmark: button that runs a graphics benchmark
Download report: link that saves the benchmark report file
Frame stats: checkbox label: show the frame rate counter
Material maps: label of a list: surface detail maps on or off
Triplanar cliffs: label: a cliff texturing technique, technical term
Scene: settings group heading for sky, fog and particles
Flat world: label: Easter egg option, draws elephants holding up the map from below, as in the flat earth myth
Projectiles: label: arrows and other projectiles shown or hidden
Status bars: settings group heading for the bars (health, capture) drawn over units and buildings
Show all status bars: label of an on/off list: draw the health and capture bars of every unit and building on screen, not only the selected ones
Range overlays: settings group heading for the range circles drawn around selected buildings
Attack ranges (Alt+C): label of a list; the key combination in brackets stays as is
Aura ranges (Alt+V): label of a list; the key combination in brackets stays as is
Heal ranges (Alt+B): label of a list; the key combination in brackets stays as is
Silhouettes: settings group heading for the unit silhouettes option
Unit silhouettes (Alt+Shift+S): label of an on/off list: draw units hidden behind buildings, trees or hills as flat shapes in their player colour; the key combination in brackets stays as is
Bloom: label: glow effect around bright areas, technical term
Depth of field: label: camera blur effect for distant objects, technical term
Assets for the 3D view: heading of a dialog about downloading and storing game files in the browser
To show the match in 3D, this observer u: first paragraph of the storage dialog: what is downloaded and why
Over time this observer may store up to: paragraph of the storage dialog; keep {size} unchanged, it is replaced with a size such as 4.2 GB
You don't need to wait for any of it. Th: paragraph of the storage dialog: the match starts right away
To load fast on any device, the graphics: paragraph of the storage dialog: graphics start at minimum quality and can be changed in the settings
<b>Warm up</b> downloads, in the backgro: paragraph of the storage dialog explaining the Warm up button; keep the <b> tags, and translate the bold word as the Warm up button is translated
Press <b>F4</b>, or tap with four finger: paragraph of the storage dialog: how to show the debug panels; keep F4 unchanged
You can delete the stored files at any t: last paragraph of the storage dialog
Warm up now: button in the storage dialog that starts the background download
Got it: button that closes the storage dialog
Fold the queue: accessible name of a button that collapses the production queue panel
Unfold the queue: accessible name of a button that expands the production queue panel
Fold the orders panel: accessible name of a button that collapses the orders panel (stance, formation, alert, barter, garrison)
Unfold the orders panel: accessible name of a button that expands the orders panel (stance, formation, alert, barter, garrison)
Fold the build panel: accessible name of a button that collapses the panel of items to train, build, research or upgrade
Unfold the build panel: accessible name of a button that expands the panel of items to train, build, research or upgrade
Fold the details: accessible name of a button that collapses the selection details panel
Unfold the details: accessible name of a button that expands the selection details panel
Fold the top panel: accessible name of a button that collapses the top bar of resources and players
Unfold the top panel: accessible name of a button that expands the top bar of resources and players
Fold the minimap: accessible name of a button that collapses the minimap
Unfold the minimap: accessible name of a button that expands the minimap
Details: label of the folded details panel tab
Orders: label of the folded orders tab on phones: stance, formation, alert, barter and garrison buttons; keep it short, the tab is narrow
Build: label of the folded build tab on phones: buttons to train, build, research, upgrade, pack and lock gates; keep it short, the tab is narrow
Queue: label of the folded production queue tab on phones; keep it short, the tab is narrow
Sound on: button label while sound is on; pressing it turns sound off
Play: button that resumes a paused replay
Stop benchmark: button label while a benchmark runs
Loading the model index: progress text while the list of 3D models is fetched
Loading models %(done)s / %(total)s MB: progress text; the two values are numbers of megabytes
Warming up %(done)s / %(total)s MB: progress text of a button; the two values are numbers of megabytes
Warmed up: button label after the background download finished
Warm up: button that downloads every game file the match may need in advance
Warm up (%(failed)s failed): button label; the value is a number of files that failed; pressing retries
Match over: status text when the match ended
Match over. Next match in %(time)s: status text; the value is a countdown such as 0:42
Live stream starts in %(time)s: status text while the delayed broadcast has not started yet; the value is a countdown such as 1:42
Default (browser: %(name)s): first entry of the language list; the value is the language name the browser asks for
warming up: benchmark phase, lower case, used inside a status line
measuring: benchmark phase, lower case, used inside a status line
Run %(index)s/%(total)s, %(phase)s: %(na: benchmark status line: run number, total, phase word, name of the setting tested
%(done)s of %(total)s runs measured, sto: benchmark result summary when stopped early
New game: heading and title of the page that sets up a game against the computer, which the server hosts
on the game setup page: another game the server hosts is running
Watch it: link from the game setup page to watch the game in progress
Back to your game: link from the game setup page back to the visitor's own game in progress
Players: game setup: label of the list choosing how many players the game has
You: game setup: the visitor plays this slot
Cannot start the game: %(error)s: game setup error; %(error)s is the server's reason, in English
